summary: Maintain runtime publications incrementally instead of rebuilding on unrelated commits

replay.detail: No claim replay. The initial publication still folds the complete runtime list.

schema.detail: No stored schema or claim changes; incremental rows remain in memory.

rules.detail: Runtime selection, subject visibility and ownership rules are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Existing runtime pages, snapshots and frozen continuations retain their format and semantics.

downtime.detail: The updated daemon uses incremental maintenance after its first complete publication.

manual.detail: No manual migration or configuration is required.

recovery.detail: Restart reconstructs the in-memory publication. Reverting restores full-fold refreshes without data conversion.
